audiences.label: Government & public sector
audiences.title: For governments and public agencies
audiences.lead: National identity, roots of trust and digital public services - designed, delivered and operated at national scale since 2006.

audiences.label: Banks & financial institutions
audiences.title: For banks, payments and fintech
audiences.lead: Onboarding, strong authentication, remote signing, open banking and secure payments - built for SBV regulation, PSD2 and eIDAS 2.0.

audiences.label: Telcos & enterprises
audiences.title: For telcos and enterprises
audiences.lead: Zero Trust access, key management, paperless contracts and trusted archives - security that runs your business, not the other way round.

audiences.label: Trust service providers & CAs
audiences.title: For CAs and trust service providers
audiences.lead: Everything a CA or qualified trust service provider runs: PKI, signing, timestamping and the readiness programs to pass WebTrust and eIDAS 2.0 audits.

audiences.label: Partners & developers
audiences.title: For partners, integrators and developers
audiences.lead: Resell, integrate or build on SAVIS: a partner program, open APIs and a global ecosystem of more than 70 technology partners.
